Hi all,

p local-id

28a44faf7fdb

Thank you so much for your attendance. Please

kindly check the meeting minutes below.

Attendees

Tao Huang, Loura Guo, Jiajin Zhong,

Daijiang Xie, Yixi Wang, Suijie Song, Guangyuan Mu, Huifang Liu, Jiaxing D

ai

p local-id

1422b8dafe39

Quick Recap

p local-id

bb8ac7200389

This meeting mainly focused on the module divi

sion and development plan for the

93 AI

8B project.

p local-id

e01ea04af2bb

Yixi led the discussion on module division bas

ed on the current system architecture. The team tentatively divided the sys

tem into five major modules

data persistence layer, data processing pipeli

ne, tool set layer, web layer, and agent integration layer. Each module own

er introduced their technical background, preferred direction, and possible

contribution to the project.

p local-id

a3ddeea945e8

The team also discussed whether the modules sh

ould be developed in parallel or strictly according to dependency order. Af

ter discussion, the team tentatively agreed to start with parallel developm

ent for efficiency, while adjusting the collaboration model if dependency i

ssues arise later.

p local-id

03772056dd99

Vincent emphasized that the team should focus

on the time constraints and deliverables of the first phase in July, avoid

over-designing the system at the early stage, and clarify the specific obje

ctives of each module for Phase 1. He also suggested that team members make

good use of AI tools to improve development and documentation efficiency.

p local-id

099c14fb2487

The meeting concluded that each module owner s

hould define the expected Phase 1 functions, deliverables, and acceptance c

riteria before Wednesday, and prepare a four-phase development plan for the

next meeting.

p local-id

9188aa1cc13c

Discussion Summary

p local-id

e254d0b8c841

Vincent and Tao discussed the project timeline

arrangement. The original plan was to arrange a session around 11th June,

but the exact time still depends on ERC

99s availability. Vincent men

tioned that he would confirm the schedule with ERC and notify the team in a

dvance. He also reminded the team to focus on the July Phase 1 deadline and

avoid spending too much time on overly complex designs at this stage.

p local-id

181a6616dc98

Yixi introduced the proposed module division p

lan. Based on the current architecture, the project will be divided into fi

ve modules

data persistence layer, data processing pipeline, tool set laye

r, web layer, and agent integration layer. The team agreed that module-base

d division can improve development efficiency, while members with extra cap

acity may support other modules later.

p local-id

8100fc0d9cfe

The team discussed the development sequence of

different modules. One option is to develop the modules strictly according

to dependencies, starting from data persistence and data processing. Anoth

er option is to let different modules proceed in parallel and resolve depen

dency issues through interface definitions, mock data, and later integratio

n. The team tentatively agreed to proceed with parallel development first.

p local-id

9dde67afadd3

Daijiang shared knowledge related to MCP, whic

h stands for Model Context Protocol. He introduced the basic interaction me

chanism between AI agents and external tools, including how the LLM communi

cates with the MCP client, how requests are passed to the MCP server, and h

ow backend tools are invoked. Vincent suggested that the team could refer t

o the Open Manus project to better understand the implementation of an MCP

server. Daijiang will share related blog links with the team.

p local-id

fd2c146a36d1

Vincent and Tao also provided suggestions on f

uture AI knowledge sharing. They suggested that when introducing technical

concepts, especially abbreviations such as MCP, the presenter should first

explain the full name and provide enough background information so that all

team members can follow the discussion more easily.

p local-id

56d9435df7de

The team members introduced their technical ba

ckgrounds and module preferences. Daijiang introduced his experience in RAG

, embedding applications, data processing, data governance, database design

, and AI-assisted engineering tools. Jiajin introduced his experience in Py

thon, databases, and data processing pipelines. Jiaxing introduced his expe

rience related to tool set development and keyword-based retrieval. Other m

embers also discussed their possible roles in the project.

p local-id

b4d0d1a45faf

The final module responsibility arrangement wa

s discussed as follows. Suijie will be responsible for the web layer. Jiaxi

ng will be responsible for the tool set layer. Yixi will prioritize the dat

a persistence layer to provide basic interfaces for the data processing pip

eline. Daijiang will be responsible for the agent integration layer. Jiajin

will be responsible for the data processing pipeline.

p local-id

872880b9aed5

The team also discussed the four-phase develop

ment plan. For the first phase, the focus should be on clarifying the minim

um deliverables and building the basic framework of each module. Later phas

es may include deeper integration, optimization, and more advanced features

. Vincent suggested that the team should consider adding some highlight fea

tures in later demonstrations, such as improving data search accuracy throu

gh wiki-style organization or similar mechanisms.

be158a375e8f
